personas.name: The Casual Commuter (Maya)
personas.profile: 30yo Professional, uses public transit. High distraction environment.
goals: Forward to Kindle via email instantly
personas.agent_instruction: Evaluate if the UI can be navigated entirely with the thumb.

personas.name: The Library Curator (David)
personas.profile: 55yo Bibliophile. Desktop user, contributes 10+ EPUBs per week.
personas.agent_instruction: Check for drag-and-drop efficiency and bulk editing capabilities.

personas.name: The Silver Reader (Elena)
personas.profile: 70yo Retired Teacher. Uses a tablet/smartphone with high font scaling.
goals: Receive books in email without 'tech' friction
personas.agent_instruction: Verify that 'Forward to Email' doesn't require complex SMTP knowledge.

personas.name: The Privacy Sentinel (Liam)
personas.profile: 28yo Cybersecurity Analyst. Extremely cautious about data harvesting.
goals: Use the app without an account
Ensure EPUBs are stripped of tracking pixels
personas.agent_instruction: Assess if the 'Forward to Email' feature can function via session-based tokens without permanent user profiling.

personas.name: The Global Student (Amina)
personas.profile: 21yo University Student in a region with high data costs and 3G speeds.
goals: Preview book metadata without loading high-res covers
personas.agent_instruction: Evaluate if the UI remains functional when 'low-bandwidth mode' is active (e.g., blurred or missing covers).
